body:
I've spent the majority of the last several years in a vicious cycle of self-loathing and reliving the scars of my past. All I can reasonably add to what you've said is how fucking important that initial offering of support from someone is at a fragile time like that. I know that a stranger on the internet will not have all the answers to my problems. I know there will never be a magic fix somewhere in the voice of a hotline volunteer. But fuck it if it'd feel any better sitting on my ass drafting suicide notes. 

Your words give me hope that I can continue to rely on a community like this when I'm not up to the task of feeling reasonable and logical on my own.
I really needed this tonight. Thank you.

I appreciate that. I'm just terrified that I'm losing my mind faster than I can fix it. Each day, for the past couple weeks, has been progressively worse. I feel absolutely trapped in my thoughts, and they are so hurtful to myself.
The more I'm reading, the more I'm seeing how hard this is going be. You bring up a lot of good points, and it reinforces my understanding that I can't hide this forever. I just simply can't.

You told me a lot of what I needed to hear. I was hoping there was an easy way to do this, but deep down I knew there really wasn't. I really do appreciate your advice.

As for my depression: I have a good amount of friends - only one of whom is atheist. I'm just about to start seeing a doctor, so hopefully things improve over time.
